question: Who among the following won the Global Gandhi Peace Award in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sheikh Mujibur Rahman**.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• On 22nd March 2021, Gandhi Peace Prize for the year 2020 was given to Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman who is also called the Father of Nation in Bangladesh.
 
• Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman was selected for the Gandhi Peace Prize 2020 unanimously by a committee chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• This year for the first time that the award has been given away posthumously. 
 
• The late Sultan of Oman, Qaboos bin Said Al Said has also been given this prize for the year 2019. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​About Gandhi Peace Prize:

 
 
• Gandhi Peace Prize is an annual award instituted by the Government of India since 1995, the 125th Birth Anniversary commemoration year of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• The Gandhi Peace Prize was instituted as an annual award for people involved in social, economic and political transformation across the world through non-violent tactics. 
 
• The award carries an amount of Rs. 1 crore, a citation, a plaque and an exquisite traditional handicraft or handloom item.
 
• The award is not just given to individuals but also to associations, institutions or organizations.
